title: A run killed mid-stage leaves durable stage evidence and a truthful terminal status
retires: F-CLASS-17 route proof missing on dead runs (terminal-truth half); R7/AC-R7.4 graceful teardown. The append-only kind:route_record ledger (AC-R5.1) is pending_lane_3.
notes: GREEN: the daemon is SIGTERM'd while the worker is running; its handler drains gracefully, writes the result, and the finally-block resets the heartbeat to 'idle' (operatord.py:574-594,1068-1070). The stage's envelope.json (route/stage evidence) is written at stage start (operatord.py:812) so it survives the kill. RED: fault SIGKILLs the daemon (no graceful drain) -> the heartbeat is frozen at 'running' (a stale lie) -> the final_heartbeat_state=='idle' assertion fails while saw_running/envelope_recorded stay true.
